answer: Re-attestations are stored in whisper and juniper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 3658 identities would post 2132 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
